prior_passes.sheet_conflicts: The task brief hypothesized an offshore Nile Delta/Mediterranean tieback for Wanda; that hypothesis is NOT supported. All corroborating reporting (Egypt's Ministry of Petroleum, TradeArabia, Zawya, EgyptToday, ArabFinance, and multiple Arabic outlets, all tracing to the same 22 July 2026 Ministry of Petroleum and Mineral Resources announcement) places Wanda ONSHORE in Egypt's Western Desert, operated by Khalda Petroleum (an EGPC/APA Corporation 50/50 JV) — not offshore, not Nile Delta. If the sheet's country/location metadata for P7605 says offshore Mediterranean/Nile Delta, that metadata itself needs review (Baird's call).
prior_passes.notes: Found the project: Wanda is a deep gas exploration well (15,000 ft) in Egypt's Western Desert, operated by Khalda Petroleum (50/50 EGPC/APA Corporation JV). Ministry of Petroleum announced (22 July 2026) it began production at 40 mmcf/d, and that Khalda built a new 10-km production pipeline ($2.3M) linking the well to 'existing infrastructure' to fast-track output ahead of national-grid tie-in expected end of July 2026. The reported 10 km pipeline length matches the sheet's stated 10.0 km exactly, strongly confirming this is the right project despite the wrong offshore/Nile-Delta assumption in the task brief. However, every source found (a dozen+ outlets, all derivative of one Ministry press release, checked in English and Arabic) is silent on: (1) which of Khalda's many Western Desert concessions/blocks (e.g. Qarun, Matruh, Shushan, Faghur Basin, Salam, Obaiyed areas) Wanda sits in, (2) the name of the 'existing infrastructure'/facility the new line ties into, (3) any coordinates, and (4) nearby named fields. This is a brand-new discovery (announced ~1 week before this research) with no field development plan, EGAS/EGPC bulletin, or map yet public. Some Arabic outlets (elaosboa.com, egcoop.com) transliterate the well name as 'Watda' (واتدا) — possible alternate spelling of the same well; not enough independent confirmation to recommend renaming the GEM entity. Recommend resolved:false with a corridor note ('somewhere in Khalda's Western Desert concession area, onshore Egypt') rather than fabricated coordinates — revisit once an EGAS annual report or more detailed trade-press follow-up names the specific concession. All 4 route_refs re-verified via url_verifier.py (200 OK).

start.coord_basis: RETRY (8 days after the original Ministry announcement) found one additional, NOT independently confirmed lead: a LinkedIn post states 'The discovery [is] located in Shushan Basin in Egypt's Western Desert.' Shushan Basin is a real, well-documented sedimentary basin in the far western Western Desert (academic literature: e.g. Springer/OnePetro papers place Khalda-operated fields there, one of which describes the wider Khalda Field area as '~460 km west of Cairo and ~70 km south of the Mediterranean coast'). However, this LinkedIn attribution is a single, non-official source, and it does NOT appear in any of the official/wire coverage (Ministry-derived: TradeArabia, Zawya, EgyptToday, ArabFinance, WAM/Emirates News Agency, BigNewsNetwork, GulfNews) -- all re-checked specifically for 'Shushan', 'Qarun', 'Matruh', 'basin', and 'concession' on this retry, and none contains any of those terms. Per the 2+ independent source standard, 'Shushan Basin' is unconfirmed and NOT used as a coordinate basis -- flagged as a lead only, not a finding. No coordinates or basin/concession confirmation exists in the corroborated record.
